descriptions.privacy: How {brand} collects, uses and protects personal data.
descriptions.terms: The terms that apply when you use {brand}.
descriptions.cookies: Which cookies and similar storage {brand} uses and why.

1.heading: Who we are
1.body:
{brand} is operated by {operatorName}, {operatorAddress} (the "operator", "we"). We act as the controller of the personal data described in this policy. This is an alpha-stage service and this policy may change as it develops.

Contact for any privacy question: {contactEmail}.

2.heading: Data we process
2.body:
Account data: your email address, display name and avatar, and your sign-in method (email and password, or Google). Passwords are handled by our authentication provider and are never stored by us in readable form.

Content you create: campaigns, characters, maps, battles, notes, scenarios and the files you upload (images, audio, imports) together with the technical records needed to run them.

Technical data: standard request data such as IP address and browser type, processed by our hosting providers to deliver the service, keep it secure and prevent abuse, plus aggregated page-view statistics without cookies. We keep the IP address, approximate country and browser/OS type of signed-in visits for 180 days to protect accounts against abuse and multi-account fraud.

Optional AI features: if you add your own AI provider key, the text you send to the assistant is passed to that provider under your own account.

3.heading: Why we use it and on what basis
3.body: We process your data to provide the service you signed up for (creating and running campaigns, real-time battles, sharing with players): performance of a contract. We also process technical data to secure and improve the service and to prevent abuse: our legitimate interest. Where we ask for it, for example optional features, we rely on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

4.heading: Service providers (subprocessors)
4.body:
We use the following providers, who process data on our behalf: Supabase (database, authentication and file storage); Vercel (hosting and Vercel Web Analytics, which measures page views without cookies); Pusher (real-time messaging during sessions); Resend (transactional email such as confirmation and password reset); Google (optional sign-in with Google OAuth); Upstash (rate limiting); and, only if you configure your own key, the AI provider you choose (bring your own key), which receives the content you send to the assistant.

Some of these providers process data outside your country, including in the United States; where required this is covered by standard contractual clauses or an equivalent safeguard.

5.heading: How long we keep data
5.body: We keep account data and content for as long as your account exists. When you delete your account in your profile (or email us at {contactEmail}), we delete your account and the content you own; backups and logs are overwritten within a limited period afterwards. Content you shared in a campaign owned by another person belongs to that campaign and stays with it. We keep technical logs only as long as needed for security and diagnostics.

6.heading: Your rights
6.body: Depending on where you live, including under the GDPR, you have the right to access your data, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to its processing, receive it in a portable format, and withdraw consent. You can edit most data yourself in your profile; you can delete your account and data in your profile, and for anything else write to {contactEmail}; we will answer within one month. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

7.heading: Security
7.body: Data is transmitted over HTTPS, access to it is limited by authentication and per-campaign permissions, and database tables are protected with row-level security. No system is perfectly secure; as an alpha service {brand} is provided without guarantees, and you should keep copies of anything you cannot afford to lose.

8.heading: Children
8.body: {brand} is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact {contactEmail} and we will delete it.

9.heading: Changes and contact
9.body: We may update this policy; the date at the top shows the latest version, and material changes will be announced in the service. Questions and requests: {contactEmail}. Operator: {operatorName}, {operatorAddress}. Governing law: {jurisdiction}.

1.heading: The service
1.body: {brand} is a web application for running tabletop role-playing campaigns: combat tracking, characters, maps, scenarios and sharing with players. It is operated by {operatorName}, {operatorAddress}. By creating an account or using the service you agree to these terms.

2.heading: Alpha status, no guarantees
2.body: The service is in alpha. It is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind. Features may change or disappear, data may be lost, and the service may be unavailable at times. Keep your own copies of content that matters to you.

3.heading: Your account
3.body: You must provide accurate information, keep your credentials secure and be responsible for activity under your account. You must be at least 16 years old. One person should not share an account with others; use campaign roles to give players access.

4.heading: Your content
4.body: You keep ownership of the content you create or upload. You grant us a limited, non-exclusive licence to store, process, display and transmit it solely to operate the service for you and the people you choose to share it with. You confirm that you have the right to upload what you add, including any images, audio and imported material.

5.heading: Acceptable use
5.body: Do not upload or share content that is illegal, infringes the rights of others, is hateful, harassing or sexually exploits minors; do not attempt to break, overload or probe the service, bypass access limits, scrape it at scale or access other people's data; do not use it to distribute malware or spam. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these rules.

6.heading: Third-party content
6.body: This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2 ("SRD 5.2") by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available at https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd and licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Icons and photos are used under their respective licences, credited in the site footer. Dungeons & Dragons is a trademark of Wizards of the Coast; {brand} is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by it.

7.heading: Termination
7.body: You can stop using the service at any time and delete your account and data in your profile, or email us at {contactEmail}. We may suspend or end access if you breach these terms or if needed to protect the service or other users, and we may discontinue the service with reasonable notice where possible.

8.heading: Limitation of liability
8.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, the operator is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of data or profit, or interruptions arising from use of the service, and total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the service, which is zero for the alpha. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

9.heading: Changes and governing law
9.body: We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version, and continuing to use the service after a change means you accept it. These terms are governed by the law of {jurisdiction}, without affecting mandatory consumer protections in your country. Contact: {contactEmail}.

1.heading: What this covers
1.body: {brand} uses only the cookies and similar browser storage that are strictly necessary to run the service and remember your choices. Because of that we do not show a cookie banner.

2.heading: Authentication
2.body: When you sign in, our authentication provider Supabase sets session cookies so that you stay signed in. They are required for the service to work and are removed when you sign out or they expire.

3.heading: Preferences
3.body: The cookie NEXT_LOCALE remembers your chosen language for up to one year. The cookie TZ stores your time zone for up to one year so that dates and times are shown correctly. Your colour palette and similar interface settings are kept in your browser's local storage on your device so that the interface looks the same on your next visit. None of these identify you to third parties.

4.heading: Activity record
4.body: The cookie cn_seen marks that we have already recorded your signed-in visit today. It is strictly technical, expires at the end of the current UTC day and is not shared with or read by any third party.

5.heading: Analytics
5.body: We measure aggregated page views with Vercel Web Analytics. It does not use cookies, does not track you across sites and does not build a profile of you.

6.heading: Control and contact
6.body: You can delete cookies and local storage in your browser settings; the service will then ask you to sign in again and reset your preferences. Questions: {contactEmail}. Operator: {operatorName}.
